python/mirage/commands/cli/builtin/tvly/ and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/builtin/tvly/ follow tvly 1.0.2
(npm @tavily/cli, https://github.com/tavily-ai/cli, commit
6a8d074867a6911cf47598700d1514881c19a44b): the program tree, options and
option descriptions of its src/program.ts and src/commands/options.ts, the
verbs of src/commands/search.ts, extract.ts, site.ts, research.ts and
auth.ts, the option checks of src/core/search-flags.ts, the research event
stream of src/core/sse.ts, the failure rendering of src/commands/invoke.ts
and src/ui/keyless.ts, and the plain-text output of src/ui/text.ts and
src/ui/render/ (emit.ts, search.ts, extract.ts, crawl.ts, research.ts),
which tvly prints when stdout is not a terminal.
python/mirage/core/tavily/ and typescript/packages/core/src/core/tavily/
send the request headers and derive the error messages of @tavily/core
1.1.0's transport (https://github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-js), the client tvly
1.0.2 sends through, and the search options are that package's search
parameter catalog.
